candidates.description: Set north workers to 8 using the observed nested JSON structure.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/app/data/services.json')
data = json.loads(p.read_text())
data['services']['north']['workers'] = 8
p.write_text(json.dumps(data, separators=(',', ':')) + '\n')
PY

candidates.description: Replace the observed north workers text while retaining the rest of the file exactly.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/app/data/services.json')
original = p.read_bytes()
old = b'"north":{"workers":2'
new = b'"north":{"workers":8'
assert original.count(old) == 1, 'Expected exactly one observed north entry'
updated = original.replace(old, new, 1)
expected = json.loads(original)
expected['services']['north']['workers'] = 8
assert json.loads(updated) == expected
p.write_bytes(updated)
PY
